ui.arcade.slayermart.choice_body: Collect cash and choose support for this run. Both players must agree.
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.01.name: Explosive Bundle
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.01.desc: Add 2 bombs. If capacity is limited, confirm the reduced amount before paying full price.
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.02.name: Boost Bundle
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.02.desc: Add 2 boosts. If capacity is limited, confirm the reduced amount before paying full price.
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.03.name: Token Bundle
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.03.desc: Gain 3 personal reroll tokens. Each reroll costs 1 token. Reopening the menu does not redraw offers.
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.04.name: Battle Chicken
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.04.desc: Summon one chicken for 5 minutes. Up to 5 chickens total. Cleared on death.
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.05.name: Saw Blade
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.05.desc: Gain a saw for 5 minutes. Merge with an existing saw without adding another ordinary orbit.
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.06.name: Saw + Barrel
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.06.desc: Saw and barrel last up to 5 minutes. The barrel still has at most 3 triggers. Existing trigger counts are not refilled.
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.07.name: Magnet Mastery
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.07.desc: Increase magnet radius and duration by 50%.
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.08.name: Decoy Mastery
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.09.name: Gloves Mastery
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.10.name: Chicken Mastery
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.11.name: Saw Mastery
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.11.desc: Double saw distance and add a second blade on the opposite side.
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.12.name: Dead Operator
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.12.desc: Increase weapon and chicken damage by 25%. Other damage sources are unaffected.
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.13.name: Armor Vest
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.13.desc: Unlock 1 armor plate slot. Plates are sold separately. One plate blocks one valid hit; lethal hazards keep their original rules.
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.14.name: Tactical Vest
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.14.desc: Upgrade to 2 armor plate slots. Keep current plates without automatically filling empty slots.
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.15.name: Armor Plate
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.15.desc: Add 1 armor plate. Requires a vest and an empty slot. Repeatable.
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.16.name: Lightning Storm
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.16.desc: Charge with 100 kills credited to you, then activate manually. For 10 seconds, deal 20 damage every 0.5 seconds within 5 m. Stun normal enemies, slow elites by 50%; bosses take damage without control.
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.17.name: Gem Geode
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.17.desc: Gain 8 to 16 standard gems for score and multiplier progress. Does not grant shopping cash.
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.18.name: Tesla Trio
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.18.desc: Gain 3 contact orbs that damage and knock back enemies. All three share a hit interval for the same target.
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.19.name: Barrel Relay
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.19.desc: Queue 3 barrels. The next starts when the current share expires or is exhausted. Does not refill current triggers.
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.20.name: Chicken Squad
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.20.desc: Summon 3 chickens in parallel for 5 minutes each. Up to 5 total. The whole purchase is rejected if they cannot all fit.
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.21.name: Respawn Mastery
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.21.desc: Increase protection after a true respawn by 50%. Other invulnerability sources are unaffected.
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.22.name: Barrel Mastery
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.22.desc: Increase barrel orbit speed and duration by 25%. The five-minute bundle still caps at 5 minutes and 3 triggers.
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.23.name: Sentry Mastery
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.23.desc: Increase supported sentry damage by 75%. Does not add new turret types.
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.24.name: Golden Shower
ui.arcade.slayermart.item.24.desc: Next normal round: +1 life for each original member up to the cap. Zero-life members use the usual respawn wait. No revival inside the shop.
